subject: prd/installer
statement: Mitigate older-reader rejection by requiring a CLI upgrade before repinning to a bundle-free v2 release.
rationale: The operator-approved retirement retains strict v1 parsing rather than silently changing its required bundle-hash contract.
fit_criterion: Regression tests accept v2 without a bundle hash, refuse v1 without a valid hash, and verify declared legacy bundles before use; the upgrade guidance precedes repinning.

provenance.note: Disposition of approved installer amendment 004 R8; no implementation result is asserted.
